rationale: The change is limited to the driver-warning presentation component (new visual layout/notification presentation). The supplied description explicitly states that obstacle information, object category information, ego-object spatial information, the Phenomenon of Interest, and the Evaluation Target are unchanged. The baseline ORRs depend on obstacle presence, object category, and braking-relevant spatial information; none of those representational bases are modified by this presentation-only change, so no ORR requires revalidation or rederivation.
